items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: But Varis Allen made about a thing. Varis Allen.

ctx.x: Did they have many bands that had singers? Oh, no. Uh-huh. They wouldn't hire singers if they were out?
No, no. Some of the guys in the band would holler, you know. But Varis Allen made about a thing. Varis Allen.
Who would do the singing in the band? Oh, different fellas. Sing.
